title: Fulfilment composition
description: Three orthogonal dimensions of how a Figaro order is fulfilled: modality (consume-onsite / pickup / delivery), courier coordination (meaningful only when modality is delivery), and the physical handoff point. Replaces figaro-fulfilment-v1 + figaro-handoff-v1 which duplicated this conceptual space across two single-enum schemas. Proximity verification of the handoff event lives in a sister schema (figaro-proximity-policy-v1).

fields.name: modality
fields.description: Top-level fulfilment modality. consume-onsite = no movement (on-premise consumption). pickup = buyer collects from seller's premises. delivery = transported to the buyer.

fields.name: coordination
fields.description: Who organizes the courier. Meaningful only when modality = delivery; the on-chain validator rejects coordination set with non-delivery modality. buyer-assigned = buyer chooses courier. seller-assigned = merchant arranges courier directly. dutch-auction = courier selected via the kernel's Dutch-auction mechanism.

fields.name: handoffPoint
fields.description: Where the physical exchange occurs. Orthogonal to modality and coordination. face-to-face = parties present together. dead-drop = pre-agreed unattended location. parking-area = curbside / lot. locker = secured drop-off box. Cryptographic proof of proximity at the handoff event belongs in figaro-proximity-policy-v1, not here.
